steps.title: Fire and light
steps.body: Vines that burn away, torch stands to light, bombs that break cracked walls, and beams of light that mirrors turn onto a sensor: they are under Starter pack › Fire and light, and each works by itself.
steps.task: Open Starter pack in the bottom dock.

steps.title: Vines, a torch and a torch stand
steps.body: Place Vines across the way 6 studs in front of the start, a Hand torch just to the right of the start, and a Torch stand to the left. The Hand torch is the Torch item: picked up, it goes into an item button.
steps.task: Place Vines, a Hand torch and a Torch stand.

steps.title: Burn the vines
steps.body: Press Play and walk over the Hand torch: it goes into item button 1 (J). Walk up to the vines and press J: a flame sets them alight, and they burn away in two seconds. Vines touching them catch too.
steps.task: Press Play, take the torch and burn the vines.

steps.title: Light the torch stand
steps.body: Walk to the torch stand and press J again: it lights and stays lit. A torch stand only answers fire, so a sword does nothing to it. A Timed torch goes out again after its seconds; Light all the torches (Scripts and cutscenes) opens a gate when they all burn.
steps.task: Light the torch stand with the torch.

steps.title: A cracked wall and bombs
steps.body: Stop the game. Place a Cracked wall to the left of the start, and a Bomb bag in front of it. Only an explosion breaks a cracked wall.
steps.task: Place a Cracked wall and a Bomb bag.

steps.title: Blow it up
steps.body: Press Play and walk over the Bomb bag: five bombs, in item button 2 (K). Stand by the wall, press K and step back: the bomb fizzes, blinks red and goes off. The wall breaks; anyone too close loses a heart.
steps.task: Press Play, take the bombs and blow up the wall.

steps.title: A beam, a mirror and a sensor
steps.body: Stop the game. Place a Sun crest to the left, turned (T) to shine away from the start, a Mirror in its beam further on, and a Light sensor to the right of the mirror. The beam runs straight from the crest until something stops it.
steps.task: Place a Sun crest, a Mirror and a Light sensor.

steps.title: Turn the mirror
steps.body: Press Play. The mirror sends the beam away from the sensor. Walk to it and press Action (E · Turn): it leans the other way, the beam turns onto the sensor and the sensor lights up. Wire it to a gate with Switch opens a gate.
steps.task: Press Play and turn the mirror until the sensor lights.

steps.title: Done!
steps.body: You burned vines and lit a torch stand with the Torch, blew up a cracked wall with a bomb, and turned a mirror to bring a beam of light onto a sensor. Make your own in the Asset studio: Fire and light › Burns, Shines a beam, Mirror; a switch Lit by a beam, or Hit by Fire.
